scope: Complete293-entry compilation reconciliation plus160 additional records/leads. Independent primary verification remains incomplete. This is a conditional reference selection, not certification of original deposition at every included site.

principal.definition: Source-qualified climactic Mazama airborne fallout reference: 42 reported point values and 20 conditional lower bounds. Compilation-supported values are not claimed independently primary-verified. The expanded bound review recovers primary components, preserved bed ranges and three georeferenced Camp Creek section groups; see BOUND_REVIEW.md. Seven additional georeferenced Yellowstone Lake locations use explicit4–5 mm beds from Morgan2023, paired cores counted once; see YELLOWSTONE.md. Nevada, Great Salt Lake, Goose Lake and Effingham Inlet add measured primary beds; Gold Lake contributes a conditional74 cm coarse-component minimum; see FOLLOWUP_SEARCH.md. One endpoint is used per physical reading, with separate range-endpoint, coherent weaker-transfer and omission refits. Known precursor totals, reworked totals and unquantified traces/proxies are omitted. No invented uncertainties, zeros or trace thresholds.

target: Climactic Mazama primary airborne bulk deposit, including co-ignimbrite ash; exclude identified older precursor units and flow/reworked material. Legacy phase correlations remain conditional where primary logs are unavailable.
thickness_convention: Preserved bulk centimetres as a proxy for original local deposition. No universal decompaction correction. Component lower bounds assume in-place primary pumice without depositional thickening.
coordinate_datum: Published decimal or DMS positions used without an undocumented datum conversion; precision does not establish survey accuracy.

prior_release.scope: Current GitHub release preceding the Mazama source revision; the earlier local audit was performed on41b8f2f. Latest five-family results remain accessible at this immutable revision.
